The m72 pair supplies two matched comparisons to an observed DCM-loading series, allowing protocol association and amount response to be considered jointly while acknowledging that solvent identity and loading-solvent volume change together. The m203 2/1 bridge, m92 2/1 anchor and matched m80/m197 solvent comparisons test concrete response-shape questions after recent labels both repaired prediction failures and exposed same-tuple variability. The m82 bridge and m86 strong-solvent anchor extend supervision across beta-keto ester and aryl amine environments with observed neighboring conditions.
